scope_findings.Chinese: Official ranked series located; complete mole-map procedure and rights not verified. Supplemental Book of Moles cataloged separately,not merged.
scope_findings.Western: Identifiable Fontaine historical section in another named work provides a feasible textual reference lead. Inventory standalone title remains bibliographically unverified; original page images and exact source edition must be checked before rules.
scope_findings.Indian: No primary Indian procedure established by ranked sources. Inventory indicative mapping is provisional,not proof of Indian lineage.
scope_findings.left_right: Named polarity must be source-specific,with explicit subject/viewer orientation and any sex-specific historical exceptions. No universal good/right or bad/left rule inferred.

feasibility.high_roi: A small source-specific historical body-region/label reference with neutral context,original locators and independently transcribed cases. No personal mole-to-character,intellect,criminality or illness inference.
feasibility.initial_candidate: Fontaine historical section only after checking original title/pages and rights; do not rename it to the unverified inventory standalone title.
feasibility.inputs: Prefer generic historical schematic/region selections. Original inventory user-entered map/consented close-up option preserved as inventory metadata,not an implemented image capability.
feasibility.outputs: Potential JSON/Markdown documentary lookup; no implementation in this audit
feasibility.avoid: No CV,diagnostic image analysis,malignancy risk,personality score or unsupported future-outcome probability.
